_comment: THE PLANET IS DECIDED. This file is the decision, and the orchestrator enforces it.
The Researcher used to invent a planet every run. That is why re-flying the exploration
grid against each revision round moved 73% of cells' scores and the twenty best cells had
zero overlap between round 0 and round 1 — every round reported 'best 7/8' and they were
different sevens. It also meant every measurement in docs/gdd-change-proposal.md was about
a planet the next run might not produce.
These are the numbers every measurement in that document was taken against. The commit
floor, the heat capacity, the 97-second EVA window, the satellite's 268.8 plunge — all of
them are properties of THIS planet. Change a value here and every one of them is void.
The Researcher still owns the reentry coefficients: drag, heating exponent, plasma onset,
reference area. It is told the planet as a constraint and the orchestrator overwrites the
planet and band blocks with these after it returns, so a Researcher that ignores the
constraint cannot silently move the ground under the rest of the crew.
The sample orbital speeds and periods are derived from the locked radius and gravity:
v  = sqrt(mu / (R + h)),  T = 2*pi*(R + h) / v
They are recomputed by the orchestrator rather than trusted from this file.
